Class WorkbenchEncryptor

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.workbench.encryption.WorkbenchEncryptor
public final class WorkbenchEncryptor extends Object
Workbench client-side payload protection (BYOK / envelope).

A thin wrapper over the core EncryptionManager that seals a .tis payload for an encrypted upload and produces the matching ProtectionMetadata.

  • BYOK -- the researcher brings a 32-byte DEK; the key never leaves the client, so wrappedDek is empty.
  • ENVELOPE -- a fresh random DEK seals the payload and is wrapped under a KEK via the core v1.2 wrap (AES-256-GCM, or ML-KEM-1024 -- the latter is W6.3/PQC territory).

Sealed-payload framing (both languages): iv(12) || tag(16) || ciphertext. Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.encryption.
